componentsShownInTurns.title: Components shown in turns
componentsShownInTurns.description: Rotation extends the existing Content/Position/Style inspector. Content keeps an ordered item list, Preview Previous/Next and Add item together; timing and pause live in a compact disclosure. Preview selection affects only the browser, while item/order/timing edits use the existing draft, Undo, Discard and Save model. A live On display line distinguishes acknowledged content from preview. The normal picker moves existing components or copies saved designs and opens the established designer for new items. Incompatible sizes require editing or explicit shared-area resizing, without shrinking fonts or moving neighbours. The outer area remains one non-overlapping canvas rectangle. Picker Close and Escape return focus to its invoking Add item button. The established paper palette, typography, tokens and responsive editor layout remain authoritative.

softwareUpdates.title: Software updates
softwareUpdates.description: Device contains visibly selected Display settings and Updates subsections. Updates leads with installed software and a manual release check, then version selection, release notes and explicit confirmation. Core and registered plugins share one pattern. Experimental channels, release URLs and signed-package upload remain under Advanced; bundled setup/recovery help also works from the supervisor. Unsaved layout drafts are retained and block installation. Stable per-control and per-target identities preserve focus across polls. Accepted updates reveal and focus progress once; later polling preserves reading position. Stages and final outcomes reflect the durable supervisor transaction, including successful rollback and required recovery. Layout draft badges/revision chrome are suppressed here. The existing paper surfaces, green state colors, typography and native controls remain authoritative.

narrative.northStar: Warm paper, green, calm utilitarian desktop editor
narrative.overview:
Paperphase is a warm paper and green, calm utilitarian desktop editor. It uses familiar native controls, clear labels and quiet borders so owners can arrange a readable e-paper display. System fonts keep the local application self-contained and consistent with the approved code-led prototype.

Paperphase leads the workspace identity. The supplied Odd Orbit logo and “Developed by Odd Orbit Software” attribution provide a modest maker signature throughout; Orbi appears on About only. The parent brand’s dark and violet artwork stays within its supplied asset and About maker card.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces, forest green actions and dark green ink.
Restrained controls, fine borders and limited shadows.
Desktop mouse and keyboard editing with accessible surrounding controls at narrower widths.
Original supplied maker artwork, with Orbi on About only.

rules.name: The Paperphase Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the editor's paper and green palette; the Odd Orbit artwork is a contained maker signature, not a replacement UI palette.

dos: Do use the current paper/green tokens and local system font stack.
Do pair state color with text, selection borders or accessible control state.
Do keep content labels visible and advanced controls separately expandable.
Do preserve explicit save/discard actions and distinguish saved, pending and displayed state.
Do preserve the supplied Odd Orbit artwork, proportions and opaque backgrounds.
donts: Don't extend Odd Orbit’s dark/violet palette across the Paperphase workspace.
Don't put Orbi in the routine editor, Data sources or Device pages.
Don't add decorative entrance animation or replace the local font stack with externally loaded fonts.
Don't blur or smooth the monochrome display frame; retain its pixelated rendering.
Don't present narrow-screen adaptations as a promise of full phone/tablet editing.
